scope: Local article and reference library; no repository model or admission changes

findings.subject: Selected catalog contrast
findings.change_and_evidence: Dark text on the salmon selected tab. The final computed colors are #151515 on #ef806b.

findings.subject: Readable graph neighborhoods
findings.change_and_evidence: Clickable unrelated nodes keep opaque text. Unrelated edges are hidden. The authority selection’s title/subtitle contrast minimum is 5.23:1.

findings.subject: Selection feedback
findings.change_and_evidence: A desktop sidebar shows the selected explanation; mobile presents it before the relationship list. Out-of-view feedback is revealed. Desktop and mobile bounds were inspected.

findings.subject: Clear entry paths
findings.change_and_evidence: Three starts: governance, agent work and exact reference. The map is a native disclosure. Article top is about 605 px on desktop and 944 px on mobile 390, previously 2016 and 2990 px.

findings.subject: Initial page delivery
findings.change_and_evidence: The complete catalog and essays have a separate offline page. Responsive WebP and lazy loading replace the eager 3 MB image. Initial payload stays below the project budget of 1 MB.

findings.subject: Exact-title search
findings.change_and_evidence: Exact title and identity matches rank first. Ledger is first among 17 full-record matches; the title-only scope returns three. Match reasons are visible.

findings.subject: Mobile diagrams
findings.change_and_evidence: Fresh mobile loads use a relationship list, with diagram mode still available. Six article SVG figures have native text alternatives. Ordinary pages contain their width at 320 and 390 CSS pixels.

findings.subject: Visible and accessible names
findings.change_and_evidence: Each graph button names its visible title and subtitle. Word boundaries are explicit across wrapped SVG text. Family and action guidance are descriptions. Name/ARIA scans show zero violations or incomplete results across ten layouts.

findings.subject: Return to graph state
findings.change_and_evidence: URLs encode view, governance lens, selected concept and walkthrough position. Reload and Back restore selection; local-file restoration also works.

findings.subject: Standing and version
findings.change_and_evidence: Definition badges label effective standing and source version separately. Exact candidate version strings remain intact.

findings.subject: Keyboard scroll regions
findings.change_and_evidence: The map and six article SVG containers have named regions and tabindex. Sequential Tab and ArrowRight panning worked. The baseline issue was not reproduced as a Chromium keyboard failure; this is a portability improvement.

findings.subject: Empty-search recovery
findings.change_and_evidence: Zero results explain the next actions and offer Browse all records. Clear returns focus to the search field.

findings.subject: Hierarchy and controls
findings.change_and_evidence: Article headings are larger and use the UI font. Primary map and catalog controls have 44 px minimum height; standalone secondary navigation has 32 px minimum height. Inline source links retain text behavior.

findings.subject: Card label bounds
findings.change_and_evidence: Titles and subtitles wrap inside 104 px cards. All ten final layouts have zero observed card text overflow; map and article arrow captions show zero measured collision or clipping.

integrity.local_paths_and_fragments: all paths and local fragment targets resolve

remaining_validation: Screen readers, speech input and other browser engines were not exercised.
Browser rendering and interaction do not prove reader comprehension; compare reading and search tasks with actual participants.
Axe still flags SVG/background contrast as incomplete. The selected-node contrast computation and screenshots cover the reviewed defect; there is no blanket accessibility conformance claim.
The full reference page intentionally retains its 2.35 MB offline catalog. It loads only when opened.
Payload measurements are a local cold browser run; no field performance or improved Lighthouse score is claimed.
Legacy combined-page anchors forward with JavaScript. Direct reference links and native record browsing remain available without JavaScript.
tool_posture: UX Evidence Validator is a seed evidence workflow, not an installed calibrated harness.
